description: Use this when the user wants a readable round-up of recent findings: this week in aging research, the notable results in a field, a list for a journal club. AgingResearch.News's plain-language stories about new papers, newest first, each checked against its paper and given with it. For every paper on a question, use search_papers.

category.description: Category slug. A paper matches when its category or its secondary category is listed.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

since.description: Only stories published on or after this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

system.description: Body system key (see `systems`). A paper matches when it involves any of them. Only papers that have been analyzed have systems.

until.description: Only stories published on or before this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_stories
